entries.3c08707ce0f392f4: This business operates izakaya chains through company-owned and franchised stores; it is the group's only reportable segment. Centered on its principal brand “Yadai-zushi” (an izakaya serving authentic artisan nigiri sushi), it has developed multiple formats in-house and operates stores from Hokkaido to Kyushu. All formats adopt open kitchens, and the company opens stores in 1.5-grade and second-grade locations around prime first-grade sites in front of stations to hold down fixed costs, a strategy it employs. Revenue in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥25,411 million; the number of stores as of March 31, 2026 was 399, or 401 including two franchised stores.
